question: Change the Containers field in corev1.PodSpec (k8s.io/api/core/v1) from []Container to a new named type ContainerList with different iteration semantics. PodSpec is used everywhere pods are created or inspected. Any code that directly ranges over pod.Spec.Containers, indexes into it (pod.Spec.Containers[0]), or assigns []corev1.Container{} literals will break because ContainerList is no longer a plain slice.
